acts.desc: Mike Wilson, the editor of the Dallas Morning News, recently got some hate mail from conservative readers. They think that the media—and his paper—are biased. So he invites them to visit and tell him why. Producer David Kestenbaum tells the story.

acts.desc: We searched for a parent who had a question for their kid...that they could only ask them after their kid was an adult. Chris' one-man show that will be airing on HBO in May. (7 1/2 minutes)
